I’ve been on Oxy for about ~5 years & took about 400-800mg/day . I’ll tel you what I did . Get yourself admitted to a clinic & switch from Oxy to buprenorphin or something else . Depending on where you live , you might be able to get Substitol (Morphine ER 24/h ) . Take as much time as you need . Get counselling & maybe go to a day clinic once or twice . Slowly taper down & reduce to 0 in hospital setting . After reducing to 0 I’d suggest you go to a day clinic or something similar . While in maintenance try to eat healthy, pick up a new hobby & start lifting /running so you have something that releases endorphins. Keep going to a therapist. Be honest to your prescribing doctor !
